newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA DENIES MERGER TALKS WITH HOIU.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA DENIES MERGER TALKS WITH HOIU.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Friday it has had neither official nor unofficial merger talks with the country's second largest bank, Hoiupank .

The Aripaev business newspaper said on Friday that Hoiupank and Tallinna Pank have started merger talks and quoted its own sources as saying that Tallinna's chairman was given authority to hold the negotiations.
"There are no unofficial talks and the issue is not being considered," chairman Rait Luukas told Reuters.
Luukas said that a merger is ruled out in the short-term but in the long-term it would depend on the bank's financial situation.
Hoiupank also said earlier that it has not started official merger talks with Tallinna Pank.
